variants.label: Visor
variants.notes: A window that is also an eye; the pupil is a terminal cursor. Reads as "a console that watches".

variants.label: Keystone
variants.notes: A Roman arch whose keystone is the V: the Latin root, carved. Inscription-style wordmark.

variants.label: Spectrum
variants.notes: An eye ringed by the eight section colours: one place that sees every part of the server.

variants.label: Noctua
variants.notes: Athena's owl keeping watch at night; the brows meet in a V. Works as a mascot too.
